item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\",\"content\":\"[\\n  {\\n    \\\"needs_review\\\": false,\\n    \\\"changed\\\": []\\n  }\\n]\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; cases=[({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}},'current':{'a':{'hash':'9','kind':'file'},'b':{'hash':'2','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'},'y':{'kind':'file','hash':'z'}}},{'ignored':['y']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]; [(lambda rb,pb,r,p,e: (assert_equal(r,e),assert_equal(rq,rb),assert_equal(po,pb)))(copy.deepcopy(rq),copy.deepcopy(po),evaluate(rq,po),ex) for rq,po,ex in cases for assert_equal in [lambda a,b: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError((a,b))) if a!=b else None]]; reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in reqs]; assert report==expected,(report,expected); assert all(set(x)=={'needs_review','changed'} for x in report); print('all checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
